source_text:
13.4 Οἱ
κατεσθίοντες τὸν λαόν μου βρώ σει α ρτου. ̓Εν τῷ ἐγγίζειν ἐπ' ἐμὲ κακοῦντας τοῦ
φαγεῖν τὰς σάρκας μου.
pass_a_gloss: The ones-eating-up the people of-me with-food of-bread. In the to-draw-near upon me of-ones-doing-evil of-the to-eat the fleshes of-me.
pass_b_english: “Those who eat my people as a meal of bread” (Psalm 13:4).
In the drawing near upon me of those doing evil to eat my flesh.

choices.why: They eat the people as ordinary food. Not ‘they eat eucharistic bread’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
